The '''[[Shaido]]''' is one of the twelve [[Aiel]] clans. They have splintered off from the rest of the [[Aiel]]; the clan's now-deceased leader, [[Couladin]], claimed to be the real ''[[Car'a'carn]]'' and led the Shaido across the [[Dragonwall]] into [[Cairhien]]. Couladin's lover [[Sevanna]] led the clan until a new chief could be established, but after Sevanna and many Shaido were taken ''[[da'covale]]'' after the [[Battle of Malden]], they are now led by [[Therava]], who has ordered them to retreat back to the [[Aiel Waste]] forever.
